# Zrzur

> Zrzur (Arabic: زرزور) is a free, open-source alternative to Discord: a chat app for friends and communities with servers, text and voice channels, screen sharing, files, roles and member management. It runs in the browser at https://app.zrzur.com and as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Arabic (right to left), English and German are fully supported.

Key facts:

- Free: there is nothing to pay in the current version, no subscription and no checkout.
- Open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0, built on an open-source foundation with licences and contributor credit kept intact.
- Servers are hosted in the European Union (Frankfurt am Main, Germany); Zrzur is run from Austria by the Zrzur team as a non-commercial project in its beta phase.
- Web app: https://app.zrzur.com. Invite links use https://zrzur.cc/<code>.
- Public servers can be found on Discover: https://discover.zrzur.com.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://zrzur.com/): what Zrzur is and who it is for
- [Features](https://zrzur.com/features): servers and channels, voice and screen sharing, files, roles and permissions, Discover, appearance
- [Download](https://zrzur.com/download): the desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, or use it in the browser
- [Guide](https://zrzur.com/guide): a short guide to finding your way around
- [About the project](https://zrzur.com/project): where Zrzur comes from and how it is built
